description: STL 3D model viewer for the Cardputer Zero: browse, open and inspect binary or ASCII STL files on the 320x170 screen.

store.summary: Pocket STL 3D viewer: browse, open and inspect models on the Cardputer Zero
store.description:
KanSTL is a 3D model viewer for the Cardputer Zero. Open an STL file from the built-in file browser, then rotate, zoom and inspect it on the 320x170 screen. Everything is drawn by a software rasterizer written for this machine: no LVGL, no OpenGL, no third-party 3D engine, no network access.

WHERE THE MODELS COME FROM
Copy STL files to the device over SSH or a USB stick (for example /home/pi/models) and open them from the file browser, or start the app with a path. Only folders and .stl files are listed, each with its size, and the last directory and selection are remembered.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Browse folders, open models, and read a clear message when a file cannot be loaded
- Binary and ASCII STL; every model is centred and fitted to the screen automatically
- Arrow keys rotate, Enter / Space zoom, Alt + arrows move the rotation centre, R / 0 reset and fit
- Auto-rotate around X, Y or the model's own Z axis; hold the key for 0.6 s to stop
- S saves a screenshot to ~/kanstl_screenshot_NNN.png
- H opens the key help; Esc only leaves the app after a deliberate 3 second hold, with a progress bar

FOUR RENDER STYLES, ONE KEY (7)
- SOLID      flat shaded faces, z-buffer, backface culling
- EDGES      solid faces with dark crease lines and a bright silhouette
- MATCAP     metallic normal-map shading with a specular highlight
- WIREFRAME  pure vector look
The raised button at the bottom always shows the style in use.

SPEED ON THE DEVICE (12,000 triangle torus, CM0)
- solid       7.8 ms/frame   about 128 fps
- wireframe  12.6 ms/frame   about 79 fps
- edges      17.8 ms/frame   about 56 fps (23.8k triangles)
- matcap     10.1 ms/frame   about 99 fps (23.8k triangles)
The status bar shows the triangle count and the rate at which frames actually reach the panel.

BIG MODELS
A 1.9 million triangle model opens at roughly 1 second per frame and peaks around 135 MB of RAM. To stay inside the memory budget, EDGES is skipped above 500k triangles and WIREFRAME above 1M triangles; a short toast says so and the viewer keeps running.

GOOD TO KNOW
- STL only, binary or ASCII; no OBJ, 3MF or STEP
- No colours or textures: what you see is the geometry itself
- Truncated files are reported ("truncated STL: 248K of 1.91M triangles") instead of showing a broken mesh, and binary files with a wrong facet count but intact data still open
- 6x8 pixel-art UI in the same visual language as the other Cardputer Zero tools
- No permissions requested: no camera, no microphone, no network, no background service. It reads the STL files you point it at and writes screenshots into your home directory.

HOW IT WORKS
C++17 and a fixed pipeline: parse STL -> transform -> z-buffer rasterise -> RGB565 framebuffer, paced at about 60 fps. An offscreen PNG mode and a benchmark mode are included for development on a desktop. GPL-3.0, source at github.com/nullbeing/KanSTL.

zh-CN.summary: 口袋 STL 3D 模型查看器：在 Cardputer Zero 上浏览、打开、旋转模型
zh-CN.description:
KanSTL 是一个运行在 Cardputer Zero 上的 3D 模型查看器。用内置文件浏览器打开 STL 文件，然后在 320×170 的屏幕上旋转、缩放、检查模型。画面由专门为这台机器写的软件光栅器绘制：不依赖 LVGL，不用 OpenGL，没有第三方 3D 引擎，也不访问网络。

模型从哪来
把 STL 文件通过 SSH 或 U 盘拷到设备（例如 /home/pi/models），再用文件浏览器打开，或者启动时直接给路径。列表只显示文件夹和 .stl 文件，每个文件都带大小，并且会记住上次打开的目录和选中的文件。

能做什么
- 浏览文件夹、打开模型；文件读不了时会给出明确原因，而不是黑屏
- 支持二进制与 ASCII STL，模型自动居中并适配屏幕
- 方向键旋转，Enter / Space 缩放，Alt + 方向键移动旋转中心，R / 0 复位并重新适配
- 可绕 X、Y 或模型自身 Z 轴自动旋转；长按该键 0.6 秒停止
- S 键把当前视图存成 ~/kanstl_screenshot_NNN.png
- H 打开按键帮助；Esc 是退出专用键，需要长按 3 秒，屏幕上有进度条

四种渲染风格，一个键循环（7）
- SOLID      平面着色，带 z-buffer 与背面剔除
- EDGES      实心面 + 深色折痕 + 亮色轮廓
- MATCAP     金属质感法线贴图着色，带高光
- WIREFRAME  纯线框
底部悬浮按钮始终显示当前的风格。

设备上的速度（12,000 三角面圆环，CM0）
- solid       7.8 ms/帧   约 128 fps
- wireframe  12.6 ms/帧   约 79 fps
- edges      17.8 ms/帧   约 56 fps（23.8k 三角面）
- matcap     10.1 ms/帧   约 99 fps（23.8k 三角面）
状态栏显示三角面数量，以及画面真正送到屏幕的帧率。

大模型
190 万三角面的模型约 1 秒一帧，内存峰值约 135 MB。为了不超出设备内存预算，超过 50 万面会跳过 EDGES，超过 100 万面会跳过 WIREFRAME，并弹出提示，查看器继续可用。

需要知道的
- 只支持 STL（二进制或 ASCII），不支持 OBJ / 3MF / STEP
- 没有颜色和贴图：显示的就是模型本身的几何形状
- 文件被截断时会明确提示（“truncated STL: 248K of 1.91M triangles”），而不是画出破面；二进制文件头里的面数不对但数据完整时仍然可以打开
- 6×8 像素风界面，和其他 Cardputer Zero 工具保持同一种视觉语言
- 不申请任何权限：没有摄像头、麦克风、网络，也没有后台服务。它只读你指定的 STL 文件，并把截图写进你的主目录

实现
C++17 固定管线：解析 STL → 变换 → z-buffer 光栅化 → RGB565 framebuffer，约 60 fps 节流。另外带离屏 PNG 输出和基准测试模式，方便在电脑上开发。GPL-3.0，源码在 github.com/nullbeing/KanSTL。
